verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a public v2 REST API at rest.ripplingapis.com. The docs cover Bearer-token auth with scopes, dated version pinning, cursor pagination, an official npm SDK and an AI-readable llms.txt, which a probe confirms is live. However, the evidence never shows IT-specific endpoints for devices, identity/access or inventory; the only concrete call named is 'List companies'. So the IT product cannot be shown to be fully drivable via the API. missing for 10: documented IT-domain endpoints (devices, app access, inventory), evidence of API coverage of IT actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Search and filter the full v2 REST API.
Pin a dated API version with the `Rippling-Api-Version` header (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
